tap: Toca las palabras en orden alfabético. La primera que toques lleva el número 1.
tapSame: Toca las palabras en orden alfabético. Si dos empiezan con la misma letra, mira la segunda letra.
notes: es-MX, tú imperative as the printed sheet (Numera/Usa); 'orden alfabético' and 'mira la segunda letra' reused from G1-245 / G1-264.
'Toca' is the standard Mexican touchscreen verb for children (not 'pulsa').

EN source audit: 'the first word you tap gets 1' reads as if any word may be tapped first; suggest 'Tap the words in ABC order, starting with the word that comes first.' 'the next gets 2' breaks the no-digit-except-1 rule for the other locales, so they stop at 1.
